technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the changes in the existing Spring XD, Spring Bus, and Ambari plugin extension points rather than introducing new deployment or configuration subsystems.
Use Apache Ambari configuration properties and provisioning hooks to expose and apply the Spring XD on YARN option.
Integrate spring-cloud-config-server using the existing Spring Bus configuration/bootstrap mechanism, preserving local configuration as a fallback.

Use representative channel workloads and profiling tools to investigate Spring Integration 4.2 performance, and apply only low-risk, backward-compatible corrective changes identified by the measurements.
Create a repeatable serialization benchmark covering the principal XD message and payload types, with results recorded as a baseline for future comparison.

Treat the Spring Bus architecture review as a technical assessment that produces documented gaps, risks, and recommended foundation-level changes; implementation is limited to changes needed by the other stories.
Implement the Ambari upgrade from Spring XD 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA through versioned package, repository, configuration, and upgrade-handling changes while retaining backward compatibility where practical.
Interpret fsUri=file:// as a request to construct Hadoop LocalFileSystem and avoid requiring a running Hadoop cluster; distributed multi-host file consistency is outside the implementation scope.
Pass explicitly configured system properties to the separate Sqoop JVM using validated property names and values, preserving existing behavior when no properties are supplied.
Use automated unit and integration tests for functional changes, supplemented by deployment validation and performance test execution where applicable.
assumptions: The existing source repositories, build environment, test infrastructure, and representative Hadoop, YARN, Ambari, Spring XD, and Sqoop environments are available.
The increment is implemented by one developer, so the estimates represent hands-on work-hours and exclude elapsed calendar time, waiting for external teams, and procurement.
The specification does not identify exact versions of spring-cloud-config-server, Ambari, Hadoop, or Sqoop; compatible versions already supported by the target Spring XD baseline will be selected.
Existing project conventions, APIs, and extension points are sufficiently documented to avoid a major framework rewrite.
U3 performance work includes investigation, a focused set of corrective changes, and regression measurements, but not a redesign of Spring Integration.
U4 produces a benchmark harness and documented baseline results; large-scale production benchmarking and infrastructure tuning are excluded.
U5 produces an architecture/design review and actionable recommendations; only directly required foundation changes are implemented in this increment.
U6 assumes the RC-to-GA upgrade is an in-place plugin and packaging/configuration update rather than a migration from an unrelated deployment platform.
U7 assumes file:// input is used in single-node or otherwise user-managed deployments, and does not require cross-machine file distribution or locking.
U8 assumes system properties are supplied through an existing XD job configuration mechanism and do not require a new user interface.
Documentation is limited to user and developer documentation for the delivered options, upgrade procedure, operational constraints, and benchmark findings.
Effort includes normal code review preparation, test maintenance, defect correction found during planned validation, and release notes, but excludes extended production support.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the relevant Spring XD, Spring Bus, Ambari plugin, Spring Integration, Hadoop filesystem, and Sqoop code paths; establish the implementation plan, compatibility boundaries, and local build/test setup.

activities.activity_name: Implement Ambari Spring XD on YARN option
activities.activity_description: Add the Ambari configuration and provisioning option needed to deploy Spring XD on YARN, including property propagation, default handling, and integration with existing Ambari lifecycle scripts.
Add unit and deployment-level tests for configuration generation, lifecycle behavior, invalid settings, and a representative cluster startup.
Add externalized configuration bootstrap and client integration for Spring Bus modules, including endpoint, application/profile, refresh, fallback, and failure-handling behavior.

activities.activity_name: Test and document Spring Bus external configuration
activities.activity_description: Create integration tests for remote, fallback, and unavailable-config-server scenarios and document configuration properties, startup requirements, and operational usage.
Define representative channel workloads, instrument and profile Spring Integration 4.2 execution, reproduce reported issues, and identify measurable bottlenecks and candidate corrective actions.
Apply focused, compatible changes based on profiling results, such as reducing unnecessary allocations, synchronization, scheduling overhead, or message-processing bottlenecks.
Run before-and-after benchmarks, add regression coverage for affected channel behavior, analyze results, and record limitations and remaining bottlenecks.
Implement repeatable measurements for serialization throughput, latency, payload size, and allocation characteristics across representative XD message and payload types.
Run the benchmark under controlled conditions, analyze results, identify likely improvement areas, and produce a baseline report suitable for future comparisons.

activities.activity_name: Review Spring Bus architecture and design specifications
activities.activity_description: Examine current architecture, design documents, module boundaries, configuration flows, messaging assumptions, and operational concerns; document foundation-level gaps and prioritized recommendations.

activities.activity_name: Implement Spring XD 1.2 RC to GA Ambari upgrade
activities.activity_description: Update Ambari plugin metadata, package and repository references, version handling, configuration compatibility, and upgrade procedures for Spring XD 1.2 GA.

activities.activity_name: Validate and document the Ambari upgrade
activities.activity_description: Exercise the RC-to-GA upgrade path, verify retained configuration and service behavior, handle upgrade failures, and write user-facing upgrade documentation.
Update filesystem URI parsing and filesystem construction so file:// selects Hadoop LocalFileSystem without requiring a running cluster, while preserving existing distributed filesystem behavior.

activities.activity_name: Test and document local filesystem support
activities.activity_description: Add tests for URI parsing, local file reads, missing files, path handling, and regression coverage for cluster filesystems; document single-node and multi-container limitations.
Extend job configuration to accept validated system properties and inject them into the command line or environment used to launch the separate Sqoop Java process, including memory-related options.

activities.activity_name: Test and document Sqoop system properties
activities.activity_description: Test property propagation, quoting and escaping, absent and invalid values, connector-specific properties, and backward compatibility; document supported usage and examples.

Run the full build and regression suite, validate interactions among configuration, deployment, filesystem, and job-launch changes, perform representative end-to-end checks, and correct defects found during validation.

activities.activity_name: Final documentation, packaging, and release notes
activities.activity_description: Consolidate configuration references, deployment and upgrade instructions, performance findings, architecture review outputs, known limitations, changelog entries, and deliverable packaging.
